La Paz County

La Paz County sits on the Colorado River along the California line, with about 16,700 year-round residents over 4,497 square miles. Parker, the county seat, and the river corridor support waterfront and recreational property, while Quartzsite draws a very large seasonal winter influx of RV and snowbird visitors on federal long-term visitor areas — so the functional population and the resident count diverge sharply by season. Irrigated agriculture along the river is the other significant land use, and the Colorado River Indian Tribes reservation covers a substantial share of the county. Median home value is $135,800 against median household income of $49,500.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 21, 2026
